name: OnyxProtocol
fix_description: In mintFresh, when totalSupply is 0 (first deposit), mint a minimum amount of cTokens to a dead address (similar to Uniswap V2 MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY) to prevent the exchange rate from being manipulated by direct token transfers to the contract.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a long multi-contract attack chain using an Aave flash loan, Uniswap swaps, custom intermediate contracts, Compound/Onyx-style market entry/borrow/liquidation mechanics, and repeated draining across several collateral markets. Writing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of oToken accounting and liquidation math rather than spotting a simple bug, so it would likely take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours.
